panels.description: This table lists every AV device in scope, showing its room, equipment class, category, vendor/model, status, last seen, firmware, error count, and basic uptime over the selected time range. Use the filters at the top (room, category, eqclass, status) to narrow the list before sorting by a column such as Status or Last seen. “Unknown” indicates an indeterminate state; “None” highlights missing metadata or missing telemetry, which is useful for data cleanup. Click a device name to open its detail view, where you can inspect recent heartbeats, error logs, and firmware information. For daily operations, triage by sorting Status to surface offline or degraded items first, then confirm that Last seen falls within your expectations for the device type. If a device appears repeatedly with “None” or very old “Last seen,” escalate for inventory/room mapping fixes or on-site checks.

-- Panel query (Status → Room → Eqclass → Category → Device) - aligned with:
--   Status: real statuses + __NO_ROOM__
--   Room: real room_nos + __NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__ / __NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__

WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position::varchar AS position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
pos_joinable AS (
  -- only positions that exist in eam_positions (so recursion can start)
  SELECT dp.position
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = dp.position
),
climb AS (
  SELECT
    pj.position                                AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno::varchar                     AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset::varchar                     AS parent_pos,
    0                                          AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar]::varchar[]   AS visited
  FROM pos_joinable pj
  JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = pj.position

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno::varchar,
    p.parentasset::varchar,
    c.depth + 1,
    (c.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar)::varchar[]
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno::varchar = ANY (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  -- positions that DO resolve to an AVR room
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no,
    c.depth
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp
    ON rp.equipmentno::varchar = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
root_per_pos AS (
  -- deepest reachable node per start_pos (even if it never hits AVR)
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos    AS root_pos,
    c.parent_pos AS root_parent
  FROM climb c
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
no_parent_positions AS (
  -- "No Parent" = joinable position that did not resolve to a room,
  -- and either: chain ends (root_parent IS NULL & not AVR) OR parent reference is broken (root_parent missing)
  SELECT r.start_pos
  FROM root_per_pos r
  JOIN eam_positions rp
    ON rp.equipmentno::varchar = r.root_pos
  LEFT JOIN pos_to_room pr
    ON pr.start_pos = r.start_pos
  WHERE pr.start_pos IS NULL
    AND (
      (r.root_parent IS NULL AND rp.eqclass <> 'AVR')
      OR (r.root_parent IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM eam_positions p2
            WHERE p2.equipmentno::varchar = r.root_parent
          ))
    )
),
no_position_devices AS (
  -- "No Position" = device.position is NULL OR device.position does not exist in eam_positions
  SELECT
    d.equipmentno,
    d.equipmentdesc,
    d.model,
    d.manufacturer,
    d.serialnumber,
    d.commissiondate,
    d.assetstatus_display,
    d.eqclass,
    d.category
  FROM eam_devices d
  LEFT JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = d.position::varchar
  WHERE d.position IS NULL
     OR p.equipmentno IS NULL
),

-- ----------------------- FILTERS -----------------------
status_input AS (
  SELECT string_to_array('${status:csv}', ',')::varchar[] AS status_arr
),
status_filter AS (
  SELECT
    ('${status:raw}' = '__all') AS is_all_status,

    -- New UX: __NO_ROOM__ in Status (keep __NO_ROOM_STATUS__ for backward compatibility)
    ('__NO_ROOM__' = ANY(status_arr) OR '__NO_ROOM_STATUS__' = ANY(status_arr)) AS want_no_room,

    ('__none__' = ANY(status_arr) OR '${status:raw}' = '__none__') AS want_none,

    -- keep only real room statuses for matching
    array_remove(
      array_remove(
        array_remove(status_arr, '__NO_ROOM__'),
        '__NO_ROOM_STATUS__'
      ),
      '__none__'
    ) AS real_statuses
  FROM status_input
),
room_input AS (
  SELECT string_to_array('${room:csv}', ',')::varchar[] AS room_arr
),
room_filter AS (
  SELECT
    ('${room:raw}' = '__all') AS is_all_room,

    -- Room variable carries the No Room subtypes
    ('__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__' = ANY(room_arr)) AS want_no_pos,
    ('__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'   = ANY(room_arr)) AS want_no_parent,

    -- optional umbrella token if it ever appears
    ('__NO_ROOM__' = ANY(room_arr)) AS want_no_room_umbrella,

    -- real rooms only
    array_remove(
      array_remove(
        array_remove(room_arr, '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__'),
        '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'
      ),
      '__NO_ROOM__'
    ) AS real_rooms
  FROM room_input
),

listed AS (
  -- ====================== Normal devices that map to a real room ======================
  SELECT
    room.equipmentno::varchar AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    CONCAT(parts.part1_txt, '/', parts.part2_txt, '-', parts.part3_txt) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    room.equipmentdesc       AS ConferenceRoom,
    room.assetstatus_display AS RoomStatus,

    d.equipmentno            AS EquipmentNo,
    d.equipmentdesc          AS DeviceDesc,
    d.model                  AS Model,
    COALESCE(ld.manufacturer, d.manufacturer) AS Manufacturer,
    ld.hostname              AS Hostname,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.commissiondate) * 1000)::bigint         AS CommissionDate,
    d.assetstatus_display    AS LeafStatus,
    d.eqclass                AS DeviceClass,
    d.category               AS DeviceCategory,

    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkLanDB,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkHostPage,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkDetails,

    parts.part1_txt, parts.part2_txt, parts.part3_txt
  FROM eam_devices d
  JOIN pos_to_room pr
    ON pr.start_pos = d.position::varchar
  JOIN eam_positions room
    ON room.equipmentno::varchar = pr.room_no
  CROSS JOIN status_filter sf
  CROSS JOIN room_filter   rf

  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  ) AS parts

  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipmentno)
           equipmentno,
           manufacturer,
           hostname
    FROM landb_ipaddresses
    WHERE equipmentno = d.equipmentno
      AND (d.serialnumber IS NULL OR serialnumber = d.serialnumber)
    ORDER BY equipmentno
  ) ld ON true

  WHERE
    -- ROOM filter: only real rooms
    (
      rf.is_all_room
      OR (cardinality(rf.real_rooms) > 0 AND pr.room_no = ANY(rf.real_rooms))
    )

    -- EQCLASS filter
    AND (
      '${eqclass:raw}' = '__all'
      OR d.eqclass = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${eqclass:csv}', ',') )
    )

    -- STATUS filter on room status (exact match)
    AND (
      sf.is_all_status
      OR (sf.want_none AND room.assetstatus_display IS NULL)
      OR (cardinality(sf.real_statuses) > 0 AND TRIM(room.assetstatus_display) = ANY(sf.real_statuses))
    )

    -- CATEGORY filter
    AND (
      '${category:raw}' = '__all'
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(d.category,''), '__none__')
           = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${category:csv}', ',') )
    )

  UNION ALL

  -- ====================== No Room: No Parent Position ======================
  SELECT
    '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'::varchar AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    'No parent position'            AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    'No Room'                       AS ConferenceRoom,
    'No Room'                       AS RoomStatus,

    d.equipmentno                   AS EquipmentNo,
    d.equipmentdesc                 AS DeviceDesc,
    d.model                         AS Model,
    COALESCE(ld.manufacturer, d.manufacturer) AS Manufacturer,
    ld.hostname                     AS Hostname,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.commissiondate) * 1000)::bigint                AS CommissionDate,
    d.assetstatus_display           AS LeafStatus,
    d.eqclass                       AS DeviceClass,
    d.category                      AS DeviceCategory,

    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkLanDB,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkHostPage,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkDetails,

    NULL::text AS part1_txt, NULL::text AS part2_txt, NULL::text AS part3_txt
  FROM eam_devices d
  JOIN no_parent_positions np
    ON np.start_pos = d.position::varchar
  CROSS JOIN status_filter sf
  CROSS JOIN room_filter   rf
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipmentno)
           equipmentno,
           manufacturer,
           hostname
    FROM landb_ipaddresses
    WHERE equipmentno = d.equipmentno
      AND (d.serialnumber IS NULL OR serialnumber = d.serialnumber)
    ORDER BY equipmentno
  ) ld ON true
  WHERE
    -- must be in "No Room" mode (or All)
    (sf.is_all_status OR sf.want_no_room)
    -- and room selection must include this subtype (or All)
    AND (rf.is_all_room OR rf.want_no_parent OR rf.want_no_room_umbrella)

    AND (
      '${eqclass:raw}' = '__all'
      OR d.eqclass = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${eqclass:csv}', ',') )
    )
    AND (
      '${category:raw}' = '__all'
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(d.category,''), '__none__')
           = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${category:csv}', ',') )
    )

  UNION ALL

  -- ====================== No Room: No Position ======================
  SELECT
    '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__'::varchar AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    'No position'                     AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    'No Room'                         AS ConferenceRoom,
    'No Room'                         AS RoomStatus,

    d.equipmentno                      AS EquipmentNo,
    d.equipmentdesc                    AS DeviceDesc,
    d.model                            AS Model,
    COALESCE(ld.manufacturer, d.manufacturer) AS Manufacturer,
    ld.hostname                        AS Hostname,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.commissiondate) * 1000)::bigint                   AS CommissionDate,
    d.assetstatus_display              AS LeafStatus,
    d.eqclass                          AS DeviceClass,
    d.category                         AS DeviceCategory,

    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkLanDB,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkHostPage,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkDetails,

    NULL::text AS part1_txt, NULL::text AS part2_txt, NULL::text AS part3_txt
  FROM no_position_devices d
  CROSS JOIN status_filter sf
  CROSS JOIN room_filter   rf
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipmentno)
           equipmentno,
           manufacturer,
           hostname
    FROM landb_ipaddresses
    WHERE equipmentno = d.equipmentno
      AND (d.serialnumber IS NULL OR serialnumber = d.serialnumber)
    ORDER BY equipmentno
  ) ld ON true
  WHERE
    (sf.is_all_status OR sf.want_no_room)
    AND (rf.is_all_room OR rf.want_no_pos OR rf.want_no_room_umbrella)

    AND (
      '${eqclass:raw}' = '__all'
      OR d.eqclass = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${eqclass:csv}', ',') )
    )
    AND (
      '${category:raw}' = '__all'
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(d.category,''), '__none__')
           = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${category:csv}', ',') )
    )
)

SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ConferenceRoom,
  RoomStatus,
  EquipmentNo,
  DeviceDesc,
  Model,
  Manufacturer,
  Hostname,
  CommissionDate,
  LeafStatus,
  DeviceClass,
  DeviceCategory,
  LinkLanDB,
  LinkHostPage,
  LinkDetails,
  ConferenceRoomNo
FROM (
  SELECT *,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part1_num,
    regexp_replace(part1_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part1_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part2_num,
    regexp_replace(part2_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part2_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part3_num,
    regexp_replace(part3_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part3_suf
  FROM listed
) s
ORDER BY
  part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
  part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
  part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
  ConferenceRoomNo,
  DeviceDesc;

    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos    AS root_pos,
    c.parent_pos AS root_parent
  FROM climb c
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
no_parent_positions AS (
  -- "No Parent" = joinable position that did not resolve to a room,
  -- and either: chain ends (root_parent IS NULL & not AVR) OR parent reference is broken (root_parent missing)
  SELECT r.start_pos
  FROM root_per_pos r
  JOIN eam_positions rp
    ON rp.equipmentno::varchar = r.root_pos
  LEFT JOIN pos_to_room pr
    ON pr.start_pos = r.start_pos
  WHERE pr.start_pos IS NULL
    AND (
      (r.root_parent IS NULL AND rp.eqclass <> 'AVR')
      OR (r.root_parent IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM eam_positions p2
            WHERE p2.equipmentno::varchar = r.root_parent
          ))
    )
),
no_position_devices AS (
  -- "No Position" = device.position is NULL OR device.position does not exist in eam_positions
  SELECT
    d.equipmentno,
    d.equipmentdesc,
    d.model,
    d.manufacturer,
    d.serialnumber,
    d.commissiondate,
    d.assetstatus_display,
    d.eqclass,
    d.category
  FROM eam_devices d
  LEFT JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = d.position::varchar
  WHERE d.position IS NULL
     OR p.equipmentno IS NULL
),

-- ----------------------- FILTERS -----------------------
status_input AS (
  SELECT string_to_array('${status:csv}', ',')::varchar[] AS status_arr
),
status_filter AS (
  SELECT
    ('${status:raw}' = '__all') AS is_all_status,

    -- New UX: __NO_ROOM__ in Status (keep __NO_ROOM_STATUS__ for backward compatibility)
    ('__NO_ROOM__' = ANY(status_arr) OR '__NO_ROOM_STATUS__' = ANY(status_arr)) AS want_no_room,

    ('__none__' = ANY(status_arr) OR '${status:raw}' = '__none__') AS want_none,

    -- keep only real room statuses for matching
    array_remove(
      array_remove(
        array_remove(status_arr, '__NO_ROOM__'),
        '__NO_ROOM_STATUS__'
      ),
      '__none__'
    ) AS real_statuses
  FROM status_input
),
room_input AS (
  SELECT string_to_array('${room:csv}', ',')::varchar[] AS room_arr
),
room_filter AS (
  SELECT
    ('${room:raw}' = '__all') AS is_all_room,

    -- Room variable carries the No Room subtypes
    ('__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__' = ANY(room_arr)) AS want_no_pos,
    ('__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'   = ANY(room_arr)) AS want_no_parent,

    -- optional umbrella token if it ever appears
    ('__NO_ROOM__' = ANY(room_arr)) AS want_no_room_umbrella,

    -- real rooms only
    array_remove(
      array_remove(
        array_remove(room_arr, '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__'),
        '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'
      ),
      '__NO_ROOM__'
    ) AS real_rooms
  FROM room_input
),

listed AS (
  -- ====================== Normal devices that map to a real room ======================
  SELECT
    room.equipmentno::varchar AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    CONCAT(parts.part1_txt, '/', parts.part2_txt, '-', parts.part3_txt) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    room.equipmentdesc       AS ConferenceRoom,
    room.assetstatus_display AS RoomStatus,

    d.equipmentno            AS EquipmentNo,
    d.equipmentdesc          AS DeviceDesc,
    d.model                  AS Model,
    COALESCE(ld.manufacturer, d.manufacturer) AS Manufacturer,
    ld.hostname              AS Hostname,
    d.commissiondate         AS CommissionDate,
    d.assetstatus_display    AS LeafStatus,
    d.eqclass                AS DeviceClass,
    d.category               AS DeviceCategory,

    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkLanDB,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkHostPage,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkDetails,

    parts.part1_txt, parts.part2_txt, parts.part3_txt
  FROM eam_devices d
  JOIN pos_to_room pr
    ON pr.start_pos = d.position::varchar
  JOIN eam_positions room
    ON room.equipmentno::varchar = pr.room_no
  CROSS JOIN status_filter sf
  CROSS JOIN room_filter   rf

  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  ) AS parts

  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipmentno)
           equipmentno,
           manufacturer,
           hostname
    FROM landb_ipaddresses
    WHERE equipmentno = d.equipmentno
      AND (d.serialnumber IS NULL OR serialnumber = d.serialnumber)
    ORDER BY equipmentno
  ) ld ON true

  WHERE
    -- ROOM filter: only real rooms
    (
      rf.is_all_room
      OR (cardinality(rf.real_rooms) > 0 AND pr.room_no = ANY(rf.real_rooms))
    )

    -- EQCLASS filter
    AND (
      '${eqclass:raw}' = '__all'
      OR d.eqclass = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${eqclass:csv}', ',') )
    )

    -- STATUS filter on room status (exact match)
    AND (
      sf.is_all_status
      OR (sf.want_none AND room.assetstatus_display IS NULL)
      OR (cardinality(sf.real_statuses) > 0 AND TRIM(room.assetstatus_display) = ANY(sf.real_statuses))
    )

    -- CATEGORY filter
    AND (
      '${category:raw}' = '__all'
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(d.category,''), '__none__')
           = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${category:csv}', ',') )
    )

  UNION ALL

  -- ====================== No Room: No Parent Position ======================
  SELECT
    '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'::varchar AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    'No parent position'            AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    'No Room'                       AS ConferenceRoom,
    'No Room'                       AS RoomStatus,

    d.equipmentno                   AS EquipmentNo,
    d.equipmentdesc                 AS DeviceDesc,
    d.model                         AS Model,
    COALESCE(ld.manufacturer, d.manufacturer) AS Manufacturer,
    ld.hostname                     AS Hostname,
    d.commissiondate                AS CommissionDate,
    d.assetstatus_display           AS LeafStatus,
    d.eqclass                       AS DeviceClass,
    d.category                      AS DeviceCategory,

    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkLanDB,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkHostPage,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkDetails,

    NULL::text AS part1_txt, NULL::text AS part2_txt, NULL::text AS part3_txt
  FROM eam_devices d
  JOIN no_parent_positions np
    ON np.start_pos = d.position::varchar
  CROSS JOIN status_filter sf
  CROSS JOIN room_filter   rf
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipmentno)
           equipmentno,
           manufacturer,
           hostname
    FROM landb_ipaddresses
    WHERE equipmentno = d.equipmentno
      AND (d.serialnumber IS NULL OR serialnumber = d.serialnumber)
    ORDER BY equipmentno
  ) ld ON true
  WHERE
    -- must be in "No Room" mode (or All)
    (sf.is_all_status OR sf.want_no_room)
    -- and room selection must include this subtype (or All)
    AND (rf.is_all_room OR rf.want_no_parent OR rf.want_no_room_umbrella)

    AND (
      '${eqclass:raw}' = '__all'
      OR d.eqclass = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${eqclass:csv}', ',') )
    )
    AND (
      '${category:raw}' = '__all'
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(d.category,''), '__none__')
           = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${category:csv}', ',') )
    )

  UNION ALL

  -- ====================== No Room: No Position ======================
  SELECT
    '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__'::varchar AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    'No position'                     AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    'No Room'                         AS ConferenceRoom,
    'No Room'                         AS RoomStatus,

    d.equipmentno                      AS EquipmentNo,
    d.equipmentdesc                    AS DeviceDesc,
    d.model                            AS Model,
    COALESCE(ld.manufacturer, d.manufacturer) AS Manufacturer,
    ld.hostname                        AS Hostname,
    d.commissiondate                   AS CommissionDate,
    d.assetstatus_display              AS LeafStatus,
    d.eqclass                          AS DeviceClass,
    d.category                         AS DeviceCategory,

    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkLanDB,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkHostPage,
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS LinkDetails,

    NULL::text AS part1_txt, NULL::text AS part2_txt, NULL::text AS part3_txt
  FROM no_position_devices d
  CROSS JOIN status_filter sf
  CROSS JOIN room_filter   rf
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipmentno)
           equipmentno,
           manufacturer,
           hostname
    FROM landb_ipaddresses
    WHERE equipmentno = d.equipmentno
      AND (d.serialnumber IS NULL OR serialnumber = d.serialnumber)
    ORDER BY equipmentno
  ) ld ON true
  WHERE
    (sf.is_all_status OR sf.want_no_room)
    AND (rf.is_all_room OR rf.want_no_pos OR rf.want_no_room_umbrella)

    AND (
      '${eqclass:raw}' = '__all'
      OR d.eqclass = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${eqclass:csv}', ',') )
    )
    AND (
      '${category:raw}' = '__all'
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(d.category,''), '__none__')
           = ANY( STRING_TO_ARRAY('${category:csv}', ',') )
    )
)

SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ConferenceRoom,
  RoomStatus,
  EquipmentNo,
  DeviceDesc,
  Model,
  Manufacturer,
  Hostname,
  CommissionDate,
  LeafStatus,
  DeviceClass,
  DeviceCategory,
  LinkLanDB,
  LinkHostPage,
  LinkDetails,
  ConferenceRoomNo
FROM (
  SELECT *,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part1_num,
    regexp_replace(part1_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part1_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part2_num,
    regexp_replace(part2_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part2_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part3_num,
    regexp_replace(part3_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part3_suf
  FROM listed
) s
ORDER BY
  part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
  part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
  part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
  ConferenceRoomNo,
  DeviceDesc;

climb AS (
  SELECT
    pj.position                              AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno::varchar                   AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset::varchar                   AS parent_pos,
    0                                        AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar]::varchar[] AS visited
  FROM pos_joinable pj
  JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = pj.position

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno::varchar,
    p.parentasset::varchar,
    c.depth + 1,
    (c.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar)::varchar[]
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno::varchar = ANY (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
         c.start_pos,
         c.cur_pos AS room_no,
         c.depth
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp
    ON rp.equipmentno::varchar = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'

  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
root_per_pos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos    AS root_pos,
    c.parent_pos AS root_parent

  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
no_parent_positions AS (
  -- joinable position, but does not reach AVR room; chain ends at non-AVR root (or broken parent ref)
  SELECT r.start_pos
  FROM root_per_pos r
  JOIN eam_positions rp
    ON rp.equipmentno::varchar = r.root_pos
  LEFT JOIN pos_to_room pr
    ON pr.start_pos = r.start_pos
  WHERE pr.start_pos IS NULL
    AND (
      (r.root_parent IS NULL AND rp.eqclass <> 'AVR')
      OR (r.root_parent IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM eam_positions p2
            WHERE p2.equipmentno::varchar = r.root_parent
          ))
    )
),
no_position_exists AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM eam_devices d
  LEFT JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = d.position::varchar
  WHERE d.position IS NULL OR p.equipmentno IS NULL
  LIMIT 1
),
no_parent_exists AS (
  SELECT 1 FROM no_parent_positions LIMIT 1
),
status_input AS (
  SELECT string_to_array('${status:csv}', ',')::varchar[] AS status_arr
),
status_filter AS (
  SELECT
    ('${status:raw}' = '__all') AS is_all,
    ('__NO_ROOM__' = ANY(status_arr)) AS want_no_room,
    array_remove(status_arr, '__NO_ROOM__') AS real_statuses
  FROM status_input
),
rooms AS (
  -- normal rooms (by real statuses)
  SELECT DISTINCT room.equipmentno::varchar AS room_no
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_positions room
    ON room.equipmentno::varchar = pr.room_no
  CROSS JOIN status_filter sf
  WHERE
    sf.is_all
    OR (cardinality(sf.real_statuses) > 0 AND TRIM(room.assetstatus_display) = ANY(sf.real_statuses))

  UNION ALL

  -- No Room reason: No Position
  SELECT '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__'::varchar AS room_no
  FROM status_filter sf
  WHERE (sf.is_all OR sf.want_no_room)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM no_position_exists)

  UNION ALL

  -- No Room reason: No Parent Position
  SELECT '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'::varchar AS room_no
  FROM status_filter sf
  WHERE (sf.is_all OR sf.want_no_room)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM no_parent_exists)
),
fmt AS (
  SELECT
    room_no AS __value,
    CASE
      WHEN room_no = '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__' THEN 'No position'
      WHEN room_no = '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'   THEN 'No parent position'
      ELSE CONCAT(
        split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
        split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
        split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',3)
      )
    END AS __text,

    CASE WHEN room_no LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL ELSE split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',1) END AS p1,
    CASE WHEN room_no LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL ELSE split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',2) END AS p2,
    CASE WHEN room_no LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL ELSE split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',3) END AS p3
  FROM rooms
)
SELECT __value, __text
FROM (
  SELECT *,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(p1,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p1n, regexp_replace(p1,'^\d+','') AS p1s,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(p2,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p2n, regexp_replace(p2,'^\d+','') AS p2s,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(p3,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p3n, regexp_replace(p3,'^\d+','') AS p3s
  FROM fmt
) q
ORDER BY
  p1n NULLS LAST, p1s,
  p2n NULLS LAST, p2s,
  p3n NULLS LAST, p3s,
  __value;

  WHERE
    (sf.is_all_status OR sf.want_no_room)
